title: Trust current criterion evidence
statement: As a product manager deciding whether work is ready, I can distinguish current passing evidence from failed, missing, excluded, or stale evidence so progress is not mistaken for delivery proof.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Quality status distinguishes covered, not_run, failed, stale, missing, and excluded states.
A passed run is not current when its test revision changes, referenced evidence is no longer current, an evidence code reference is stale, or the source repository differs.
Completing a work item does not make its criterion delivery-ready without a current passing verification or integrated immutable evidence.
